summary: Hardcoded outbound endpoint in bin/scan-only.js requires human review
details: bin/scan-only.js contains a hardcoded URL (https://sentry.citadel-casino.com) referenced from fetch/POST calls at lines 159-186. The file is a CLI bin entry, so the network call would fire when a user explicitly invokes the tool, not on `npm install` or on `require()` of the package as a library. Without semantic verification of what data is sent and under what conditions the endpoint is contacted, intent cannot be confirmed: the URL could be a legitimate telemetry/error-reporting endpoint (the hostname pattern resembles a self-hosted Sentry instance), a configurable default, or a hardcoded exfiltration sink. The package name (`scan-only`) and the destination (`citadel-casino.com`) are also a mismatch worth a human's eye. Routing to review so a maintainer can inspect what is posted, whether the endpoint is configurable, and whether the destination domain is publisher-controlled.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
